queue.claim: In OpenCV 4.x, SOLVEPNP_DLS and SOLVEPNP_UPNP both fall back to EPnP, UPnP does not estimate focal length, SOLVEPNP_ITERATIVE needs at least 6 non-planar points for its DLT initialisation (at least 4 planar), P3P/AP3P take exactly 4 points, and SQPnP takes at least 3.
